title: `st.popover` with `st.date_input` opens the date input dropdown
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Related to #9243:

While it's fine to autofocus the first element in a popover/dialog, if the first element is an `st.date_input`, it will not only focus that element but also open its dropdown. That feels like a clear bug to me, which is creating a very annoying and confusing UX, see video below. 

Note that e.g. for `st.selectbox`, the dropdown does not open if it's inside a popover. This also happens in `st.dialog`. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/505e68e3-1fe4-47ec-ad9a-8ddd14f19267

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import streamlit as st

with st.popover("Show details"):
    st.date_input("Select a date")
```

### Steps To Reproduce

Run app, click on popover. 

### Expected Behavior

Date input is focused, but dropdown is closed. 

### Current Behavior

Dropdown is open. 

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.53

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-13633)

This bug occurs when `st.date_input` is the first widget inside an `st.popover` or `st.dialog`. When the popover/dialog opens, it auto-focuses on the first focusable element (the date input field). The BaseWeb Datepicker component used by `st.date_input` is designed to open its calendar dropdown when the input receives focus, which creates the unintended UX of the calendar immediately appearing when the popover opens. This contrasts with `st.selectbox` which only opens on click, not focus.

**Root cause**: The combination of two behaviors: (1) popover/dialog auto-focus on first widget, and (2) BaseWeb Datepicker opening on focus. A fix could either modify the autofocus behavior in popover/dialog, or prevent `st.date_input` from opening on programmatic/initial focus (only on user click).

### Related Issues

- **#9243** - [Don't autofocus first element in `st.popover` and `st.dialog`](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9243): This is the parent issue that #13633 is directly related to. The current bug is a specific manifestation where the autofocus on `st.date_input` causes its dropdown to automatically open.

- **#8284** - [`st.popover` not closing when opening another PopOver](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/8284): Related popover/dropdown interaction bug where dropdown-containing widgets inside popovers cause UI state issues.

This is a confirmed bug related to the auto-focus behavior in `st.popover` and `st.dialog` containers. When a popover/dialog opens, it auto-focuses the first focusable widget inside it. For `st.date_input`, this focus event triggers the calendar dropdown to open automatically, creating a confusing UX. The root cause is in the BaseWeb Popover component's default `autoFocus` behavior combined with the BaseWeb Datepicker's behavior of opening its calendar when receiving focus. The fix likely involves either disabling auto-focus on the popover/dialog containers or preventing the date picker from opening on focus.
